title: Strengthen recovery-work journal observations and helper-scan coverage
outcome: The deterministic recovery work oracle detects missing journal observations and accurately bounds or describes the under-lock helper work it covers, without restoring elapsed-time assertions.
acceptance: The active single-run fixture requires non-vacuous observations for every recovery journal phase, with a behavioral control that would reject missing or bypassed journal instrumentation.
Under-lock helper scans have appropriate per-run or per-candidate coverage, or comments and test names explicitly limit the asserted work bound to the observed capture/planning paths.
Relevant recovery and scheduler tests retain canonical read counts, current-authority revalidation, journal preservation and real negative controls, with no timing thresholds or sleeps reintroduced.
